verdict.rationale: The evidence shows DeepInfra serving LLM chat completions through an OpenAI-compatible API. That means its hosted models answer natural-language prompts. It does not mean users can operate the DeepInfra platform itself (deployments, billing, model selection, endpoints) with natural-language commands. No first-party NL control surface, assistant, or agent interface for managing the product appears in the pack, so this adjacent capability earns no credit.
